checkpoints.title: Cape Finisterra (Zero Kilometer Stone), Spain
checkpoints.summary: Stood at the Atlantic promontory where medieval pilgrims ended their westward walk, tightened my pack straps, and turned eastward toward Shikoku.

checkpoints.title: Cee, Galicia, Spain
checkpoints.summary: Descended from the coastal eucalyptus ridges into Cee; received two rain-speckled apples and hot mint infusion beside a stone wall in the spirit of donativo and Osettai.

checkpoints.title: Santiago de Compostela, Galicia, Spain
checkpoints.summary: Walked uphill through the misty oak valleys of Negreira and entered the granite heart of Santiago, greeting westbound finishers while continuing east toward the Pyrenees.
